hashContract.canonicalization: Hash the exact JSON string value after JSON decoding, with no leading or trailing newline.

apiNotes.negativePromptBehavior: Meshy's current Text-to-3D task object marks negative_prompt as deprecated and without functional impact. The exact negative prompts below are provenance and QA constraints; their essential exclusions are also written into each positive prompt.
apiNotes.creditPolicy: Create preview tasks only at first. Do not submit refine tasks until preview geometry is accepted and the displayed or returned credit cost is clear.
apiNotes.previewPolicy: No ultra mode. Smart Topology targets are sized for a mobile proof and request both GLB and USDZ.
apiNotes.refinePolicy: If explicitly approved after preview review, refine one accepted asset at 2K with PBR disabled before refining any additional asset.
